Hi Marissa,

Quick heads-up — our payment for invoice INV-7713 (€62,500) failed during card processing this morning. Stripe returned decline reason: issuer_declined (3DS authentication failed at issuer). The payment attempt id is py_1JX... and Stripe flagged a potential dispute if we don’t resolve within 7 days.

We need two things from Redwood to proceed:
- Confirmation you can accept a wire transfer and the bank details to send funds.
- If possible, reissue the invoice to our UK entity (Zenith AI UK Ltd, VAT GB999888777) — our procurement prefers to pay from that account to avoid VAT complications.

I’ve attached the invoice (INV-7713.pdf) for reference. If we don’t resolve quickly, my finance team may open a dispute with Stripe which would be messy for both sides — we’d like to avoid a chargeback.

Can you confirm next steps by EOD?

Thanks,
Liam
